headline: Callahan's Passage and Stlican Shelf Boil as Fisherman's Row Cools
war_summary: Since the last edition, the fighting has moved on. Callahan's Passage, merely stirring at last report, now shows eleven base events in the past day, six of them in the final two hours, with The Latch and The Procession changing hands repeatedly and heavy casualties on both sides. Stlican Shelf has likewise quickened, adding four events in two hours and twenty-five on the day, chiefly around The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch. Weathered Expanse remains a roaring front: forty events in twenty-four hours, five in the last two, with Necropolis and Spirit Watch the busiest ground, and casualties among the highest in the war. Fisherman's Row, leading earlier, has gone quiet in the past two hours though its day tally still stands at forty-five events. Stonecradle has flared into view with three two-hour events at The Long Fast and fierce exchanges. Oarbreaker adds a pair of fresh events; DeadLands, after its morning burst, has gone still. Farranac Coast remains hushed. No victory has been declared.
